story: The European Parliament approved a broad package of updated agreements with Switzerland by 584 votes to 13 in Strasbourg on Wednesday, sending the next steps back to Bern.
South Africa’s Western Cape High Court set aside the Section 89 panel report on the Phala Phala affair as unlawful, halting parliamentary impeachment steps against President Cyril Ramaphosa.
China launched Shenzhou-24 from Jiuquan carrying Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani to reach orbit and the first foreign astronaut to board the Tiangong space station.
The US Army detonated the nation’s entire stockpile of about five tons of degraded lead azide at an Iowa ammunition plant, and early EPA monitors detected no airborne lead.
A federal jury in Brooklyn convicted Chinese telecom company Huawei on 10 of 12 counts, including bank fraud and conspiracy to steal trade secrets, while acquitting it of racketeering.
